title: Assistant Security Officer
summary: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur is inviting applications from eligible candidates for the position of Assistant Security Officer on a regular basis. Interested candidates must apply by sending their detailed resume to the official email address on or before December 5, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institution.
Minimum 03 years of relevant experience in security operations in a University, Hospital, Government or Corporate organization.
Experience in monitoring CCTV systems and maintaining security-related records.
Ability to supervise security guards, monitor their attendance and ensure proper duty allocation.
how_to_apply_steps: Prepare a detailed resume along with supporting documents.
Mention the subject of the email as 'Application for Assistant Security Officer'.
Send the email application to hr.head@mgug.ac.in on or before 05th December, 2026.
